policy: References identify inputs but do not upgrade simulated values to real or real-derived. All route, demand, population, and capacity values in this scenario remain simulated.

inputs.note: Fixed-seed synthetic population and persona shares; not observed passenger data.
Fixed only for reproducibility; it is not an observed value.
Six selected corridor stations produce 30 directed OD pairs with equal simulated demand weights.

inputs.value: Seed-backed C-Route query at the fixed departure time
inputs.note: The seed adapter forces simulated provenance; route candidates are not verified service guarantees.

inputs.value: C-Route route_parameters from the current seed-backed engine
inputs.note: Scenario estimates are not operator-reported headways, vehicle capacity, or residual capacity.
The scenario does not resolve the service window through data/calendar.json.

known_gaps: No verified passenger-demand, residual-load, or operator capacity feed is connected.
Service-day and public-holiday rules from data/calendar.json are not applied to this fixed-time scenario.
Capacity is counted by route_id; overlapping physical line segments across distinct route IDs cannot be pooled or partitioned with the current C-Route contract.
Results are algorithm demonstrations and must not be presented as measured passenger flows, verified operational capacity, or operational forecasts.
